# Double-S.T.E.A.L: The Second Clash - recompiled game executable.
# main.c brings up the runtime and jumps to the XBE entry point;
# recomp/recomp_manual.c is where a function the lifter got wrong is
# replaced. Everything in recomp/gen/ is generated by regen.sh (gitignored).

# The generated code (regen.sh).
set(DS2_GEN_SUBDIR "gen-tkd" CACHE STRING "recomp/<dir> holding the generated C")
set(DS2_GEN_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp/${DS2_GEN_SUBDIR}")
file(GLOB RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${DS2_GEN_DIR}/*.c")

add_executable(doublesteal2
    main.c
    settings.c
    options_row.c
    skin.c
    prof.c
    recomp/recomp_manual.c
    recomp/recomp_native.c
    recomp/recomp_hooks.c
    ${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES}
)

target_link_libraries(doublesteal2 PRIVATE xboxrecomp)
if(TARGET xbox_enhance)
    target_compile_definitions(doublesteal2 PRIVATE DS2_HAVE_ENHANCE)
    target_include_directories(doublesteal2 PRIVATE ${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/src/enhance)
endif()

target_include_directories(doublesteal2 PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp
    ${DS2_GEN_DIR}
    ${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/include
    ${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/src
    ${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/src/kernel
)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(doublesteal2 PRIVATE /W4 /WX- /O2 /bigobj)
    set_source_files_properties(${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "/w")
    target_compile_definitions(doublesteal2 PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    target_link_options(doublesteal2 PRIVATE
        /DYNAMICBASE:NO /FIXED:NO /MAP /DEBUG /STACK:16777216 /OPT:NOICF)
    target_link_libraries(doublesteal2 PRIVATE d3d11 dxgi dxguid xinput winmm dbghelp)
else()
    target_compile_options(doublesteal2 PRIVATE -Wall -Wno-unused-parameter)
    # The takedawn branch's log macros (XR_ERROR...), force-included in its
    # own libraries; the generated code and main.c want them too.
    if(EXISTS "${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/src/platform/xr_log.h")
        target_compile_options(doublesteal2 PRIVATE
            "SHELL:-include \"${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/src/platform/xr_log.h\"")
    endif()
    # The generated chunks warn by the thousand.
    set_source_files_properties(${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-w")
    set(DS2_GEN_OPT "" CACHE STRING
        "Extra compile options for the generated sources only (e.g. -O1)")
    if(DS2_GEN_OPT)
        separate_arguments(_ds2_gen_opt NATIVE_COMMAND "${DS2_GEN_OPT}")
        set_property(SOURCE ${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES} APPEND PROPERTY
            COMPILE_OPTIONS ${_ds2_gen_opt})
    endif()
    # Unstripped and exported, so the fault handler's dladdr names the
    # generated sub_XXXXXXXX a crash happened in.
    target_link_options(doublesteal2 PRIVATE -rdynamic)
    target_link_libraries(doublesteal2 PRIVATE dl)
endif()

# bin/ by default; a second build tree (the other toolkit, an experiment)
# names its own so it does not replace the one in use.
set(DS2_BIN_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin" CACHE PATH
    "Where the doublesteal2 executable is written")
set_target_properties(doublesteal2 PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY         "${DS2_BIN_DIR}"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${DS2_BIN_DIR}"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG   "${DS2_BIN_DIR}"
)

# The title's enhancements defaults beside the executable, where
# xbox_enhance_init looks (recomp_exe_dir). Copied only when missing, so a
# player's edits survive a rebuild.
if(TARGET xbox_enhance)
    add_custom_target(ds2_enhance_toml ALL
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DSRC=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/config/enhance.toml
                -DDST=${DS2_BIN_DIR}/enhance.toml
                -P ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/copy_if_missing.cmake
        VERBATIM)
endif()
